A RESEARCH STUDY FOR CANCER SURVIVORS

Help inform development of ThriveWell, a digital tool that creates personalized recipes aligned with cancer prevention guidelines.

I’m interested ↗ Learn about the study ↓

The Study

What is this research study about?

This research study is designed to better understand how cancer survivors interact with a digital health tool and to collect information that will inform its development. The digital health tool being evaluated is a recipe generator called ThriveWell that provides personalized recipes aligned with cancer prevention guidelines.

Visit the Vitality Lab website ↗

Get to Know ThriveWell

Life after cancer can bring different dietary needs. Your perspective can help us understand how a digital tool fits into that experience.

Many cancer survivors face challenges related to symptom management, budget constraints, flavor preferences, and other dietary needs. ThriveWell is designed to find recipes that align with the cancer prevention guidelines while tailoring recommendations to your specific needs and preferences. It can be easily accessed through any web browser (e.g., Safari, Chrome, Firefox).

What will I do?

If you agree to participate and are eligible, you will be asked to:

  • Complete surveys on your demographics, health, and technology use
  • Join a 60-75 minute focus group (via Zoom or in-person, depending on scheduling and preferences)

The focus group and surveys are estimated to take 60-75 minutes to complete.

Compensation:

You will receive a $100.00 electronic gift card upon completion of the focus group and surveys.

Am I eligible?

In order to participate in this study, you must meet all of these criteria:

  • You are 18 years of age or older
  • You were diagnosed with non-metastatic cancer within the last 10 years
  • You have completed primary cancer treatment (surgery, chemotherapy, radiation) at least 3 months ago
  • You are able to access the internet and are reachable by telephone
  • You possess a device to use for study-related activities
  • You are able to read and write in English
